name: Compute Cluster S67: Hurst Exponent Regime Detection
description: Tests: rolling_hurst_exponent(window), hurst_exponent(min_period). H<0.5=mean-reverting, H=0.5=random, H>0.5=trending. Strategy selection by regime.
source:
# =============================================================================
# COMPUTE CLUSTER S67: Hurst Exponent
# =============================================================================

src = study_assets()
close = src.c

# === ROLLING HURST (time-varying regime detection) ===
h_roll = rolling_hurst_exponent(window=100)(close)

# === EXPANDING HURST (stable long-term estimate) ===
h_exp = hurst_exponent(min_period=50)(close)

# === REGIME CLASSIFICATION ===
mean_revert = h_roll < 0.45
trending = h_roll > 0.55

# === REPORTERS ===
xy_lines(
    title='Rolling Hurst Exponent (100d)',
    category='Regime',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Rolling H', color=Color.Blue)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=h_roll)

xy_lines(
    title='Expanding Hurst Exponent',
    category='Regime',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Expanding H', color=Color.Green)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=h_exp)

event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        icon=Icon.ArrowDownIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(title='Hurst', dp=3, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat),
            ColumnSpec(table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
        ],
        title='Mean-Reverting Regime (H < 0.45)'
    )
)(h_roll, mean_revert)

event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        icon=Icon.TrendingUpIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(title='Hurst', dp=3, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat),
            ColumnSpec(table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
        ],
        title='Trending Regime (H > 0.55)'
    )
)(h_roll, trending)
